answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable before publication and publicly verifiable afterward. A participant commits to an identity-bound task before the pulse; the beacon-derived seed then selects its inputs—tundra, lagoon, and saffron—and determines the proof checks. This blocks advance computation and reusable offline farming across invented identities, though identity or resource controls are still needed to limit participation.
